artworks.title: Reverendi Doni: Josephi Hall Norwici Nuper Episco. (Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich)
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting from the waist up. He has a beard and mustache, with hair covered by a cap. He wears a high, round ruff, a long robe with patterns and broad sleeves. The man is writing on a paper on a table while holding another paper. He wears a medallion and the background has a wall lined with books and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Johannis Heydon (John Heydon)
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated and looking directly at the viewer. He has long, wavy hair, a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and a straight nose. He is dressed in period clothing with a cloak and a lace collar. There are bookshelves, a coat of arms, a small table with an animal figure, and a draped curtain in the background. An inscription at the bottom reads "Johannis Heydon" with additional text.

artworks.title: Edward Leigh
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man seated at a table from the waist up. He has long hair, facial features like a nose and lips, and a small goatee. He is focused on writing on a piece of paper on the table, with two ink pots next to him. There is a bookshelf with books in the background against a plain wall.

artworks.title: Sir Jonas Moore
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man seated from the waist up. He is facing left, with his head turned back towards the viewer. He has distinct facial features, wavy hair, and is wearing a cloak over a tunic. His right hand is resting on a paper or scroll. Two globes are on the table beside him, one with a compass and geometric figure, and the other with numbers. The background has textured shading and partially visible text. The inscription at the bottom reads "EFFIGIES JONÆ MOORE A: Ætat:35. 1649."

artworks.title: Francis Quarles
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting with his body turned slightly to the side. His right hand is near his chest, and he has a mustache, a pointed beard, wavy shoulder-length hair, and is looking directly at the viewer. He wears a large collar garment and a lace-frilled shirt. In his left hand, he holds a quill pen. The image is framed and features a coat of arms in the top left corner. The background shows a landscape with a building, trees, sun, clouds, and decorative borders. Text is included in the illustration.

artworks.title: Wilhelmi Ramesey (William Ramsay, M.D.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is turned slightly to the viewer's left, with his right hand raised and index finger extended upward. He has distinct facial features including a prominent nose and lips, with his eyes looking slightly towards the viewer. He has long, curly hair that falls to his shoulders and is wearing a draped garment, possibly a cloak, over a shirt with ruffled sleeves. A decorative bracelet is worn on his left wrist. In the background, there is a large tree trunk to the left and an elaborate shield or coat of arms to the right. Above his head and to the upper right, there is an astronomical diagram. The lower half of the image contains text, including what seems to be a name and additional writing or poetry.

artworks.title: Mr. Henry Smith
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting the Reverend Henry Smith seated and facing slightly to the right. He has a neatly groomed beard and short hair. He wears a high-collared garment with ruffled lace at the neck and holds a quill over an open book on the table. His left hand is raised, and the background features a patterned design. An inscription at the bottom describes his identity and profession.

artworks.title: Mr. Henry Smith
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing a half-length depiction of a man positioned facing slightly left, with his body and head turned slightly towards the viewer. The man has a thin face with sharp, detailed features and a short, neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His hair is medium length and combed neatly back. He is wearing a dark, high-collared garment with visible buttons along the front. Around his neck, he wears a white ruff collar. In his right hand, he is holding a piece of fabric or the corner of a page, while his left hand gestures outward. In front of him is an open book with visible but illegible text. The background features a large framed object, delineated with parallel lines.

artworks.title: Mr. Henry Smith
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated man looking directly at the viewer. He has a square facial structure with a short beard and mustache, and short, wavy, light-colored hair. He is wearing dark clerical attire with a high lace ruff collar. He is holding a closed book in his left hand. The background has a simple line-etched frame. Text at the bottom identifies him as "The lively Portraicture of the Reverend and Learned Minister of Jesus Christ Mr. Henry Smith."

artworks.title: Benjamin Spenser (?)
artworks.description: The image displays a man in a frontal seated position. He has a prominent nose, pronounced lips, and a small beard. His hair is shoulder-length, wavy, and parted in the center. He wears a dark garment with a white collar and extended cuffs. In his left hand, he holds a human skull on a table. His right hand is raised in a gesture. The background includes a curtain on the left and a cloud on the right with three descending light beams. The frame has inscriptions like "LIGNO CHRISTI FIXUS," "Sursum," and "Deorsum."

artworks.title: Sir George Wharton
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body, including his head and shoulders. The man is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a prominent nose, full lips, and a determined gaze. His hair is long, dark, and wavy, falling over his shoulders. He is wearing a dark cloak or mantle over a collared shirt fastened with a small clasp or tie at the throat. The background consists of a simple oval frame with a crosshatch design. Below the portrait, there is an inscription written in a decorative script.

artworks.title: Sir George Wharton
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. The man is positioned facing forward, displaying his upper torso up to just below the shoulders. His features include a prominent nose, defined cheekbones, and a small mustache with a tuft of hair on his chin. He has long, wavy hair that falls past his shoulders. He is dressed in a formal suit from an earlier era with a white collared shirt, a decorative cravat, and a buttoned-up vest. The background is a textured dark oval frame. Below the image, there is text in an old-fashioned style written as a verse.

artworks.title: Sir George Wharton
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in a semi-profile position. His facial features include a pronounced nose, a small goatee, and a subtle smile. He has long, dark, wavy hair and is wearing a collared shirt with a cloak draped across his shoulders. The portrait is surrounded by an intricately illustrated oval frame. There is text at the bottom of the image. The background is plain, and the frame adds a decorative element to the image.

artworks.title: Leonard Willan
artworks.description: The image shows a bust sculpture of a figure from the chest up. The person's head is turned slightly towards the viewer, showcasing distinct facial features like a mustache and small goatee. Curly hair falls around the face to shoulder length. The sculpture wears clothing resembling classical attire. It is mounted on a two-tiered pedestal. Stylized clouds populate the sky in the background with vertically aligned lines creating depth. Text with ornate borders is present in the lower portion, possibly an inscription about the individual.

artworks.title: Thomas Wilson
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing a man's head and upper torso. He is facing slightly to his left and has a high forehead, bushy eyebrows, a long beard, and is wearing a cap. He is wearing a garment with a high ruffled collar and textured fabric. The background consists of an oval frame with the word "W I L S O N" inscribed, crosshatching inside, and a rectangular border. Below the oval frame is a panel of text.

artworks.title: Title Page to John Gauden's Hieraspistes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a title page for a literary work. The image features a detailed design for a work by John Gauden, called "Hieraspistes: A Defense of the Ministry and Ministers of the Church of England." The drawing includes intricate decorations such as angels, ribbons with inscriptions, a lion, and a figure holding a book. There is also a sun emblem at the top center, surrounded by clouds and eyes. The image blends religious and regal symbols, reflecting the themes of the work. Various text styles are incorporated into the composition, enhancing the visual complexity and emphasizing the message of the title page.

artworks.title: Title Page to F. Rous' Works
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of six separate panels featuring allegorical scenes with religious and moral themes. 

The top-left panel depicts a figure pointing to a globe with phrases "God is my portion" and "Vanity of Vanities," alongside a hovering celestial hand. 

The top-right panel shows two female figures labeled "Truth and Love" and "Error and Vices," with smaller figures looking upwards. 

The middle-left panel shows a figure offering a globe, saying "All these will I give thee" to another kneeling figure. 

The middle-right panel features a seated figure beside tablets inscribed with the Ten Commandments and other documents. 

The bottom-left panel presents a figure with a document marked with "Eternity," next to a globe. 

The bottom-right panel illustrates a classical figure holding a scroll with "The Marriage of the Lamb is come." 

The style resembles that of Thomas Cecil, with typical design elements of 17th-century moral illustrations.

artworks.title: Title Page to History of the Warres of the Emperour Justinian
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a detailed, classical-style historical title page. The image features an ornate display, with an architectural frame enclosing a text panel titled "The History of the Warres of the Emperour Iustinian" in an elaborate script. At the top, a portrait of a crowned figure labeled "Justinianus" is flanked by two winged figures. The architectural elements include column-like structures and a horizontal entablature.

The lower part includes two armored, helmeted figures on either side of the text. Below them are other figures depicted in various attire and distress. The lines and shading emphasize the dramatic character of the illustration. At the bottom, the names "Bellisarius" and "Narses" are visible.

artworks.title: Title Page to the Conveyancers Light
artworks.description: The image shows six men in separate archway compartments around a central panel. Each man is depicted in a traditional seated portrait style, facing forward or slightly to the side. They have facial hair with styles like beards and moustaches, varying hairstyles and formal attire. The men are not wearing any visible jewelry. The central panel displays engravings detailing the text "The Conveyancers Light." Below this, a small scene illustrates two figures interacting. The background features arches and decorative elements.

artworks.title: John Donne
artworks.description: An engraved portrait of a man displayed within an ornate architectural setting. The portrait is an oval, showing only the subject's head and the upper part of his torso. The individual is positioned facing slightly to the left while looking directly at the viewer. He has a bearded face with prominent cheekbones and lips, and his hair is styled neatly, framing his forehead. The man wears a high pleated ruff collar and a dark robe or cloak over his shoulders. Surrounding the portrait are decorative elements, including cherubs or putti holding scrolls on either side, and a classical pediment with elaborate scrollwork above. Below the portrait, a plaque is inscribed with text. Flanking the plaque are niches containing sculptures of classical figures. The scene is framed by an architectural facade featuring pilasters and draped fabric motifs.

artworks.title: Martin Billingsley, Writing Master
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man with a prominent mustache and pointed beard, styled hair, and wearing a high ruff and doublet. He is holding a quill pen, within an ornate frame inscribed with "LINGUA PENNA MENTIS MUETA" in Latin. The frame includes scrolls and a coat of arms, with a date of 1651 and a poetic verse below the portrait. The artwork features cross-hatch shading for texture.

artworks.title: William Barriffe
artworks.description: The image shows a print featuring a portrait of a man with shoulder-length, wavy hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He is dressed in an elaborate outfit with a lace collar and a decorative metal plate or breastplate across his chest. The portrait is surrounded by an ornately decorated frame with a military theme, including a helmet and armor pieces. The background includes a draped cloth and artistic decorations, and a banner at the bottom contains text in an elegant script.

artworks.title: Satire in Relation to Charles I and His "Eikwn Basilika"(Image of a Ruler)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man with a crown, holding his head with one hand and a skull with the other. He wears a high-collared garment and a necklace, positioned in front of a curtain. Two standing figures are slightly to the right, with one wearing a hat and a tunic, holding another hat, and the other having long curly hair and a longer coat. In the background is a circular object with text, surrounded by swirling dark lines. A text block with a poem is displayed below the scene.

artworks.title: Ralph or Rudolph Corbie, Society of Jesus
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing slightly to his left. He has a distinguished face with a subtle expression, featuring a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, and a well-defined nose. His eyes are slightly narrowed. The man has dark wavy hair, a mustache, and a thin beard. He is wearing a dark garment with a high collar and there is a rope with a tassel on his left side. The background is plain and textured, with an inscription in Latin at the bottom identifying the person as P. Rodulphus Corbie Societatis Jesu.
